teks: Record `sele0111` (WFDB format: sele0111.hea, sele0111.dat). Use signal channel 0. Consider only the beats whose R peak lies between sample 150440 and sample 157637 (inclusive, 0-based sample index). For each such beat, QT = time from QRS onset to the end of the T wave. RR = interval from the previous beat's R peak to this beat's R peak, in seconds; skip QTc for the first beat in the window. Report the mean QT in milliseconds over these beats, and the mean Bazett-corrected QTc (QT / sqrt(RR)) in milliseconds. Answer as FINAL: {"qt_ms": <number>, "qtcb_ms": <number>}.
